answer: Tie every new account to a public beacon: each epoch the beacon issues a fresh task, and each identity must post a copper bond of 35 tokens held for 9 epochs. A farm of 60 clones locks 60 x 35 = 2,100 tokens and repeats 60 tasks every round, while an honest agent pays 35 once. If clones share funding within one horizon of 9 epochs, a slash takes 40% of 2,100 = 840 tokens.
